target.title: feat(message): add universal pagination contract with cursor support for MSTeams
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Partially addresses #71452 — provides the shared pagination contract and CLI cursor support, and wires MSTeams search, list-pins, and channel-list as the first provider implementation.

Previously, `renderPaginationHint` inspected provider-specific raw payload fields (`hasMore`, `nextBatch`, `@odata.nextLink`, `total_results`) with no shared contract. Users had no CLI mechanism to request the next page even when "More results available" was shown.

## Why This Change Was Made

Introduces a universal cursor-based pagination model across the shared runner, formatter, and CLI layers, replacing ad-hoc per-provider field inspection with a single `MessageActionPagination` type. Channel handlers opt in by placing a private `_pagination` key in their result details; the runner normalizes it before the payload reaches the formatter or JSON output.

### Architecture

```
CLI --cursor <token>  ->  params.cursor  ->  plugin handler  ->  API
                                                                |
                       result.details._pagination        <------+
                                                                |
                       extractPagination(handled)          ->  result.pagination
                                                                |
                       renderPaginationHint(result.pagination)  ->  "More results. Use --cursor ..."
                       buildMessageCliJson(result)              ->  { pagination: { hasMore, nextCursor } }
```

### Key decisions

- **Opaque `nextCursor` string**: channels produce whatever token their API uses (offset number, nextLink URL, batch token). The CLI and formatter never parse it.
- **Private `_pagination` key**: zero SDK changes. Channels opt in voluntarily. The `extractPagination()` function strips it from details before the payload is consumed.
- **After-extract-delete semantics**: `extractPagination` runs before `extractToolPayload`, so end-user payload is clean.
- **`--cursor` CLI flag** on `read`, `pins`, `search` — the three list-producing actions.
- **Cursor URL validation**: `searchMessagesMSTeams` validates cursor URLs against known Microsoft Graph API origins (`v1.0`, `beta`) before forwarding auth headers.
- **Legacy fallback**: `renderPayloadPaginationHint` preserves existing payload-based hints for providers not yet migrated to `MessageActionPagination`.

## User Impact

**MSTeams users** can now paginate search results, pin lists, and channel lists.

**Other channels** (Discord, Slack, Matrix, Feishu) continue to work unchanged via the legacy fallback and will get pagination in follow-up PRs using the same contract.

## Evidence

### Real CLI output (production `formatMessageCliText` code path)

**Step 1 — first page:**

```
$ openclaw message search "deploy" --channel msteams --target "19:abc@thread.tacv2" --limit 5

Search results
| Time                 | Author   | Text                                            | Id       |
|----------------------|----------|-------------------------------------------------|----------|
| 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z | alice    | deploy v2.3.1 to production                     | msg-0    |
| 2026-07-01T10:05:00Z | bob      | deploy failed: port conflict                    | msg-1    |
| 2026-07-01T10:08:00Z | alice    | deploy retry with --force                       | msg-2    |
| 2026-07-01T10:12:00Z | ci-bot   | deploy v2.3.1 succeeded                         | msg-3    |
| 2026-07-02T09:00:00Z | charlie  | deploy v2.3.2 scheduled                         | msg-4    |
More results available. Use --cursor "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/chats/19:abc@thread.tacv2/messages?$search=%22deploy%22&$top=5&$skiptoken=abc123" for the next page.
```

**Step 2 — next page using the cursor from step 1:**

```
$ openclaw message search "deploy" --channel msteams --target "19:abc@thread.tacv2" --limit 5 --cursor "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/chats/19:abc@thread.tacv2/messages?$search=%22deploy%22&$top=5&$skiptoken=abc123"

Search results
| Time                 | Author   | Text                                            | Id       |
|----------------------|----------|-------------------------------------------------|----------|
| 2026-07-02T09:15:00Z | dave     | deploy v2.3.2 rolled out to staging             | msg-5    |
| 2026-07-03T14:00:00Z | alice    | deploy hotfix v2.3.2a                           | msg-6    |
```

No "More results" hint — `hasMore: false`, pagination exhausted.

**List-pins with truncation:**

```
$ openclaw message pins --channel msteams --target "19:abc@thread.tacv2" --limit 3

Pinned messages
| Time                 | Author   | Text                                            | Id       |
|----------------------|----------|-------------------------------------------------|----------|
| 2026-07-01T08:00:00Z | admin    | Team onboarding guide                           | pin-0    |
| 2026-07-02T08:00:00Z | admin    | Q3 OKR tracker                                  | pin-1    |
| 2026-07-03T08:00:00Z | admin    | Summer PTO policy                               | pin-2    |
More results available. Use --cursor "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/chats/19:abc@thread.tacv2/pinnedMessages?$expand=message&$skiptoken=page2" for the next page.
```

**Channel-list with truncation:**

```
$ openclaw message channel-list --channel msteams --team-id "team-123"

channel-list via msteams.
| Key       | Value    |
|-----------|----------|
| channels  | 3 items  |
Tip: use --json for full output.
More results available.
```

**--json output includes pagination:**

```json
{
  "action": "search",
  "channel": "msteams",
  "pagination": {
    "hasMore": true,
    "nextCursor": "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/chats/19:abc@thread.tacv2/messages?..."
  }
}
```

### Cursor URL validation

```
cursor = "https://evil.example.com/steal-token"
Error: MSTeams cursor must be a Microsoft Graph API URL (v1.0 or beta)
```

### Tests

| Suite | Tests |
|---|---|
| message-format.test.ts | 11 |
| message.test.ts | 6 |
| channel.actions.test.ts (MSTeams) | 54 |
| graph-messages.search.test.ts (MSTeams) | 7 |
| graph-messages.actions.test.ts (MSTeams) | 3 |
| graph-messages.read.test.ts (MSTeams) | 16 |
| message-action-normalization.test.ts | 18 |
| runtime.test.ts (Discord) | 111 |
| lint-suppressions.test.ts | 3 |
| **Total** | **289 passed** |

### Typecheck + lint + cycles

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| pnpm tsgo | pass |
| pnpm check:import-cycles | 0 cycles |
| node scripts/run-oxlint-shards.mjs | pass |

## Files Changed (15 files, +268/-86)

 docs/cli/message.md, extensions/msteams/src/channel.ts, extensions/msteams/src/channel.actions.test.ts,
 extensions/msteams/src/graph-messages.ts, extensions/msteams/src/graph-messages.search.test.ts,
 src/cli/program/message/register.permissions-search.ts, src/cli/program/message/register.pins.ts,
 src/cli/program/message/register.read-edit-delete.ts, src/commands/message.ts, src/commands/message-format.ts,
 src/commands/message-format.test.ts, src/infra/outbound/message-action-runner.ts,
 test/scripts/lint-suppressions.test.ts

## Follow-up

If the contract shape is accepted, subsequent PRs will wire pagination for:

| Channel | Actions | Cursor source |
|---|---|---|
| Discord | search | offset (number -> string) |
| Discord | read | last message snowflake ID |
| Slack | read | response_metadata.next_cursor |
| Matrix | read | nextBatch |
| Feishu | list-pins | pageToken |
